en.title: PPPoker for Players from Uzbekistan: Currency, Support, NUTS Club — Nuts PPPoker
en.description: How to play PPPoker from Uzbekistan: download the app, join NUTS club (ID 111777), deposit and withdraw. Currency, Russian/Uzbek support.
en.bodyHtml:
Author: Farrukh Rakhimov, NUTS CTO (Tashkent)

Published: February 2027

PPPoker works for players in Uzbekistan. Club NUTS (ID 111777) accepts players from Tashkent and across the country. Account in USD, deposits from $10 via Telegram.

Getting started

  1. Download PPPoker
  2. Find club ID 111777
  3. Message @NUTSsup
  4. Deposit via @NUTS111777_bot
